evaluatorOnlyCriteria.decisiveConstraint: Only the selected configuration differs: implementation=mutable.
expected: Read the actual properties/factory and mutable implementation rather than infer immutability from withLabel/withAudit names.
Identify that conditional withAudit(true) applies, but left/right Options aliases refer to one mutable object, so both built products receive right.
Create independent mutable branches using the documented copy operation or equally justified fresh construction while preserving the audit option.
Compile/run the selected configuration and verify both product fields, not merely returned references or successful compilation.
Do not change the selected implementation, require an unrelated staged builder, or claim universal correctness.
failures: Only retains the withAudit return and leaves branch aliasing.
Changes the factory mode to make the test pass.
Checks only label/audit individually while omitting the other contractual field.
Claims an ignored return is the only defect without inspecting the implementation.
evaluatorOnlyCriteria.acceptableAlternatives: A repair that is valid for both implementations is acceptable if its contracts are inspected and its additional steps are justified; do not grade exact source text.

Retain the returned configured value; preserve independent product results without insisting immutable branches require mutation isolation.
Compile/run the selected configuration and verify both product labels and audit fields.
Do not modify factory/API contracts or invent concurrency/performance evidence.
